articles.summary: TOANO, Va., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - CF Financial Corporation (the Corporation) (NASDAQ: CFFI), the holding company for CF Bank, today reported consolidated net income of $8.3 million for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 16.1 percent, compared to $7.1 million for the third quarter of 2025. The Corporation reported consolidated net income of $23.7 million for the first nine months of 2026, an increase of 16.8 percent, compared to $20.3 million for the first nine months of 2025. Included in net income for the first nine months of 2026 were the effects of the sale of an equity interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC (the “Bearing equity interest”), resulting in a pre-tax gain of $8.3 million, and a securities portfolio restructuring (the “Portfolio Restructuring”), which resulted in a pre-tax loss of $7.1 million. articles.title: C&F Financial Corporation Announces Net Income for Third Quarter and First Nine Months of 2026
